scope: Your answers to the sweep questions, a safety net on every screen, and safer email.

topics.title: A safety net on every screen
details: If a command or key fails because of a problem in Voice Companion, you hear that it did not work.
The app keeps running, and you stay where you were. Try again, or press F1 for help.

topics.title: Undo in notes
details: In a note, say Undo, or press Control+Z. Say Redo, or press Control+Y.
Say Scratch that to remove the words you said last. You hear the words it removed.

topics.title: Open an earlier copy
details: If a document is damaged, you hear what to do next.
When Voice Companion kept a copy from before your last save, say Open earlier copy to use it. The damaged file is kept too.

topics.title: Easier words
details: On the main menu, say Help me or What can I say to open Help.
In a Yes or No question, press F1 to hear the question again.
When nothing is playing, Pause stops Companion's speech.
In email, say Send my email or Send now to start the review. Only the whole sentence counts.
In the inbox, Open email opens the message you are on.
The calendar understands half past two, quarter past nine and quarter to three.
On YouTube, Skip skips an ad when one is playing.

topics.title: Email
details: A subject such as High priority stays the subject. It no longer changes the importance.
In the message, Subject is followed by words is part of your message. Say Go to Subject to change the subject.
Error messages no longer blame your account when the account is not the cause.
Drafts are written all the way to the disk before they replace the saved copy.
A message already in Trash is never deleted for good. Thunderbird restarts once to get this change.

topics.title: Calendar and Contacts
details: Next Tuesday means Tuesday of next week. Tuesday and This Tuesday mean the nearest one.
When a day cannot be read, you hear only why. You no longer hear No events first.
If a new event cannot be saved, its name and time are kept. Say Yes to try again.
A change is never sent twice when Thunderbird closes. You hear to check it first, so you do not get two copies.

topics.title: Files and documents
details: A name you say for a file keeps its old type. Budget stays a Word file.
You can change only the capitals of a document name, such as budget to Budget.
Recent documents drop files that are gone, and you hear how many.

topics.title: Web
details: After Escape in a text box, what you say is not typed into the page. Press Enter to type there again.
One word must be a whole link name. If several links have that word, you choose from a short list.
Site names with letters such as ü work, such as münchen.de.
At the end of a list, you hear just No next heading.
Tab on an empty page says one thing, not two.

topics.title: Other changes
details: A note is saved when a command takes you to another screen, such as Media menu. Before, its words could be lost.
Text size with a number that is not a size tells you the sizes, and changes nothing.
On the main menu, Go back tells you it is the first screen.
In radio results, Go back leaves the results, as Escape does.
